newsitem.title: USA: Heartport launches U.S. commercial sales.
newsitem.headline: Heartport launches U.S. commercial sales.

text.p: Heartport Inc said Tuesday it made a full-scale U.S. commercial launch of its Port-Access minimally invasive cardiac surgery systems more than 18 months earlier than expected.

"Accelerated launch, complete with full-scale manufacturing, marketing and sales, enables Heartport to satisfy the pent-up and growing demand for the Port-Access systems from leading medical centers," said chief executive Dr. Wesley Sterman.
The company said it has received orders from more than 50 high-volume U.S. cardiac surgery centers for its systems.

To date, about 240 operations have been performed using Port-Access systems, which allow surgeons to perform heart surgery through small incisions between the ribs on a stopped heart with the patient on a standard heart-lung bypass circuit.
The procedure eliminates the need to crack open the chest as is customary in traditional heart operations.
